statement: Theorem C of claude/locality.md: if psi, beta, gamma are continuous and piecewise smooth on a finite straight-line partition of the square and, at every interior point, 4[[2 p_h, p_d + q_h],[p_d + q_h, 2 q_d]] - xi xi^T is positive semidefinite (xi = (2q - psi_h, 2p - psi_d), p = (beta+gamma)/2, q = (beta-gamma)/2), then (D2) of Theorem D holds for all pairs; with Lemma S (an edge replaced exactly by a chain through zero-mass labels).
quote: the pair condition (D2) of Theorem D only has to be checked INFINITESIMALLY
